loginForm.title: Login to your account
loginForm.description: Enter your email below to login to your account

signupForm.title: Create your account
signupForm.description: Fill in the form below to create your account
signupForm.passwordDescription: Must be at least 8 characters long.
signupForm.accountCreated: Your account has been created successfully. We've sent you an email with a link to verify your email address.

addEmailForm.title: Reset your password
addEmailForm.description: Enter your email below to reset your password. You will receive an email with instructions on how to reset your password.
addEmailForm.passwordResetLinkSent: A password reset link has been sent to your email address.

comparePasswordForm.title: Create a new password
comparePasswordForm.description: Enter your new password and confirm it below.
comparePasswordForm.passwordChangedSuccessfully: Your password has been changed successfully. You can now login with your new password.
comparePasswordForm.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
comparePasswordForm.passwordMustContainAtLeastOneUppercaseLe: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
comparePasswordForm.passwordMustContainAtLeastOneLowercaseLe: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
comparePasswordForm.passwordMustContainAtLeastOneNumber: Password must contain at least one number.
comparePasswordForm.passwordMustContainAtLeastOneSpecialChar: Password must contain at least one special character.
comparePasswordForm.samePasswordError: The new password must be different from the current one.
